steps.prompt: New quest: read {quest} (and the code it cites). Write the spec to {run}/spec.md following your role card, with numbered test cases and hand-checked expected values, and a who-touches-what table (builder: src + scripts + bb.edn; tester: test files only; give le-docteur any README/GDD/TASKS wording the quest implies). Reply when it's written.

prompt.un-automate-monde: Spec: {run}/spec.md (quest: {quest}). Implement it in the source files the spec assigns the builder, and nothing else. Run .crew/gate.sh before replying.
prompt.le-testeur: Spec: {run}/spec.md (quest: {quest}). Write its test cases in the test file the spec assigns the tester, and nothing else. The builder is coding in parallel.

steps.prompt: Run the gate (.crew/gate.sh) and write the gate note to {run}/gate-note.md as your role card says.

Review the round's changes against {run}/spec.md and {quest}: git diff for edited files, and read the new files (git status lists them). Check in particular: one blueprint validator (not copied into the bb script); the merge is pure, tested, and a no-op on unchanged :as-of; new blueprints are seated and drawn without remounting or moving anything else; the author line fires once per new id and not for blueprints present at load; the bridge reads the file at request time; writes are atomic and tests never touch state/; DEMO skips the new poll; no member, pet or person named in code; no npm deps. Write the review to {run}/review.md.
Spec: {run}/spec.md (quest: {quest}). Make only the documentation edits the spec's who-touches-what table gives le-docteur (if none, change nothing). Reply with git diff --stat of what you changed.
